hints.title: Cumulative Grid Step Minimization Obstacle
hints.text: Moving from the top-left to bottom-right corner allows only down or right movements, accumulating values from each visited cell. How can computing the minimum incoming arrival cost establish the cheapest total path?

hints.title: Arrival Minimum Substructure Invariant
hints.text: The minimum path sum to reach cell (r, c) is its own value plus the minimum of the accumulated costs to reach (r - 1, c) and (r, c - 1).

hints.title: 1D Row Reduction Procedure
hints.text: Initialize a 1D array with prefix sums of the first row. For each subsequent row, update the first column by adding the cell value to the previous row entry. For other columns, update the entry to the cell value plus the minimum of the current entry (from above) and the preceding entry (from the left). Return the last element.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass over M x N grid updates a 1D buffer of length N.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive path enumeration evaluates (M+N-2 choose M-1) paths which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compressing full table into 1D row takes O(N) space instead of O(M * N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Achieving O(N) space or performing in-place modification on the grid.
